title: Southern 3-Ingredient Spicy Ranch Squares
creator: JoCooks
ingredients: 1 packet spicy ranch seasoning mix (approximately 1 ounce)
Cooking spray or parchment paper, for the dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease or line an 8-inch or 9-inch square baking dish.
Separate the biscuits and cut each into 4–6 small pieces.
Place the biscuit pieces in a large bowl.
Add the shredded cheddar and spicy ranch seasoning.
Toss gently until the pieces are evenly coated.
Spread the mixture into the prepared baking dish in an even layer, pressing gently together without packing tightly.
Bake for 20–25 minutes, until golden and cooked through in the center (loosely cover with foil if the top browns too fast).
Cut into squares and serve warm, with ranch or your favorite dipping sauce.
notes: Recipe taken from the creator's blog post linked in her pinned Reel comment (https://modawantelarab.blogspot.com/2026/11/southern-3-ingredient-spicy-ranch.html). The Reel caption mentions flaky biscuit dough, but the blog says regular refrigerated biscuits work best and to avoid flaky-layer varieties. Spicy ranch heat varies by brand.
